name: M.N. Srinivasu
profile: Indian payments pioneer who co-founded BillDesk in 2000 with fellow Arthur Andersen consultants Ajay Kaushal and Karthik Ganapathy. A commerce graduate and IIM Ahmedabad MBA, he spent nearly a decade at ITC before consulting. BillDesk grew into one of India's largest online payment gateways (FY21 revenue ~Rs 2,124 crore); a planned $4.7B sale to PayU was called off in 2022.
interesting_fact: BillDesk started as 'one convenient bill payments aggregation platform', deliberately avoiding competing with banks (its customers) in trading or lending.
deep_cut_fact: The founders spent four years persuading state telecom BSNL to sign on as a biller, finally landing it in early 2006 - a breakthrough account. Srinivasu: 'The DNA of the company is such that we've never had to play up what we do.'
notes: Very low-profile founders; BillDesk rarely does press ('never had to play up what we do'). No press email published on the BillDesk site (only support/sales addresses). Current exact title not confirmed (search budget exhausted).

name: Matthew Chaiken
profile: Co-founded Blink Health with his brother Geoffrey; as President he oversees product, engineering, data science and analytics and manages key accounts. Blink launched in 2016 as a prescription-discount service and has since become BlinkRx, a pharma-partnered home-delivery platform for branded drugs. Previously an investor at Marble Arch Investments and Merchants' Gate Capital.
interesting_fact: BlinkRx now partners with drug makers to get branded medicines delivered free in all 50 states, claiming 40% more fills covered by insurance.
deep_cut_fact: He graduated from Yale with a BA in Biology and started out as a Citigroup investment banker before moving into investing at Merchants' Gate Capital and Marble Arch Investments.
notes: Low public profile; brother Geoffrey (CEO, lane 081) is the public face. Bio source is an org-chart site (marked unverified there) - double-check before quoting. No press email found.

name: Madeline Lawrence
current_role: Co-founder & Chief Growth Officer, Aikido Security
profile: Former venture capitalist turned operator who co-founded Ghent-based developer security platform Aikido Security in 2022 and runs growth as CGO. She rose through European VC to partner at a EUR150M fund by age 25, known for viral pranks and punchy critiques of the VC industry. Aikido is billed as Europe's fastest cybersecurity company to unicorn status.
interesting_fact: She became a partner at a EUR150M venture fund by the age of 25 before 'making the jump to the light side' as an operator.
deep_cut_fact: Fresh out of law school she founded her own micro-fund, before climbing the ranks of European venture capital.
notes: Outspoken, media-friendly (known for VC-industry commentary) - likely the most receptive Aikido founder for a podcast. LinkedIn linked from Aikido's About page.
